name: AURAS Pay – Crypto Payments for WooCommerce (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDC, USDT)
author: Auras Pay

sections.description:
AURAS Pay is a cryptocurrency payment gateway for WooCommerce that lets your online store accept crypto payments in minutes. Turn your WordPress + WooCommerce shop into a crypto-ready business and start accepting Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), USD Coin (USDC) and more — directly to your own wallet, with no middleman and no chargebacks.

Whether you sell physical products, digital downloads, subscriptions, or services, AURAS Pay gives your customers a fast, secure, and modern crypto checkout experience powered by blockchain technology and web3 wallets.

Why accept cryptocurrency payments on WooCommerce?

The crypto economy is growing fast, and millions of customers now prefer to pay with digital assets. By adding a crypto payment gateway to your WooCommerce store you can:

  • Reach global crypto users who don’t use traditional cards or banks
  • Eliminate costly card processing fees and fraudulent chargebacks
  • Settle payments peer-to-peer, directly on-chain, to a wallet you control
  • Offer a privacy-friendly, borderless checkout that works 24/7

Supported Cryptocurrencies

  • Bitcoin (BTC) — the world’s leading cryptocurrency and store of value
  • Ethereum (ETH) — the foundational smart contract and DeFi blockchain
  • Solana (SOL) — ultra-fast, low-fee blockchain payments
  • USD Coin (USDC) — a fully-backed stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US dollar

More tokens and blockchain networks are added regularly.

Key Features

  • ✅ Multi-Cryptocurrency Crypto Payment Gateway — accept BTC, ETH, SOL, and USDC at checkout
  • ✅ QR Code Crypto Payments — customers scan and pay instantly from any mobile crypto wallet
  • ✅ Web3 Wallet Friendly — works with Phantom, MetaMask, Trust Wallet, and other popular wallets
  • ✅ Real-time Blockchain Verification — automatic on-chain payment detection and confirmation
  • ✅ Webhook Notifications — instant, reliable payment status updates for every order
  • ✅ Automatic Fiat-to-Crypto Conversion — price products in any fiat currency, get paid in crypto
  • ✅ Non-Custodial Payments — you keep full control of your funds and private keys
  • ✅ No Chargebacks — blockchain transactions are final and fraud-resistant
  • ✅ Stablecoin Support — accept USDC to avoid crypto price volatility
  • ✅ Mobile Optimized Crypto Checkout — a seamless payment experience on every device
  • ✅ Detailed Logging & Debug Mode — easy troubleshooting for developers and merchants
  • ✅ Secure by Design — encrypted API communication and verified webhook signatures

How Crypto Checkout Works

  1. Your customer selects AURAS Pay at WooCommerce checkout
  2. They choose their preferred cryptocurrency (BTC, ETH, SOL, or USDC)
  3. They scan a QR code or tap to open their crypto wallet
  4. They confirm the blockchain payment from their wallet app
  5. The order is automatically completed once the payment is verified on-chain

Why Choose AURAS Pay for Crypto Payments?

  • Fast Blockchain Transactions — payments confirmed in seconds, not days
  • Low Cost — no payment processing fees, only standard blockchain network (gas) fees
  • Global Reach — accept crypto payments from customers anywhere in the world
  • No Chargebacks or Fraud Reversals — cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible
  • Privacy Focused — no sensitive personal or card data required from customers
  • Always On — the blockchain never sleeps, so your store never stops accepting payments
  • Non-Custodial & Secure — your crypto goes straight to your wallet

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores that want to accept Bitcoin and crypto online
  • Digital product and download sellers
  • International merchants avoiding card and currency barriers
  • Web3, NFT, DeFi, and crypto-native brands
  • Any WooCommerce business looking to add cryptocurrency as a payment method

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • AURAS Pay account and API key (Sign up here)
  • SSL certificate (recommended for production)

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Sign up for an AURAS Pay account at auraspay.com
  3. Get your API key from the AURAS Pay dashboard
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > AURAS Pay
  5. Enter your API key and configure your settings
  6. Enable the crypto payment gateway
  7. Start accepting cryptocurrency payments!

Documentation & Support

  • Plugin Documentation
  • API Documentation
  • Video Tutorials
  • Support Forum
  • Contact Us

Developer Friendly

This crypto payment plugin is built with developers in mind:

  • Clean, well-documented code
  • WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards
  • Extensive hooks and filters
  • REST API integration
  • Webhook support
  • Debug logging

Privacy Policy

AURAS Pay for WooCommerce does not collect or store any personal information from your customers. All payment processing is handled by AURAS Pay. Please review the AURAS Pay Privacy Policy for more information.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

  • AURAS Pay API – For payment processing (Terms | Privacy)
  • CoinGecko API – For cryptocurrency price data (optional) (Terms | Privacy)
  • ExchangeRate API – For fiat currency conversion (optional) (Terms)

Credits

  • Icons by Tabler Icons
  • Cryptocurrency price data by CoinGecko

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AURAS Pay” or “crypto payments for WooCommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  2. Click on “AURAS Pay”
  3. Check “Enable AURAS Pay”
  4. Enter your API Key (get it from AURAS Pay Dashboard)
  5. Configure your preferred settings:
    • Default cryptocurrency
    • Payment timeout
    • Currency conversion source
  6. Copy the Webhook URL and add it to your AURAS Pay dashboard
  7. Save changes
  8. Test the payment flow with test API credentials
sections.faq:
What is a cryptocurrency payment gateway?

A cryptocurrency payment gateway lets your WooCommerce store accept digital currencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and USDC as payment. AURAS Pay handles the blockchain payment flow, verifies the transaction on-chain, and confirms the order automatically.

Which cryptocurrencies can I accept?

You can accept Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), and USD Coin (USDC). Customers choose their preferred cryptocurrency at checkout. More coins and networks are added over time.

Do I need a cryptocurrency wallet?

Yes, you need a crypto wallet to receive payments. You can use any wallet that supports the cryptocurrencies you want to accept (for example Phantom for Solana, MetaMask for Ethereum, or any BTC wallet).

Is AURAS Pay non-custodial?

Yes. AURAS Pay is non-custodial, meaning crypto payments go directly to your own wallet. You always stay in control of your funds.

How do I get an API key?

Sign up for a free account at auraspay.com, complete the verification process, and generate your API key from the dashboard.

Are there any transaction fees?

AURAS Pay does not charge transaction or service fees on payments. Transactions occur directly between customers and merchants, with no intermediaries. Only standard blockchain network fees (gas fees) may apply, depending on the selected cryptocurrency and network conditions. Merchants only pay for their chosen API subscription plan, which provides access to AURAS Pay’s gateway, integrations, and merchant tools.

How long does it take to receive crypto payments?

Payments are typically confirmed within seconds to a few minutes, depending on the blockchain network. Solana is usually the fastest (1-2 seconds).

Can I accept stablecoins like USDC?

Yes! You can accept USDC, a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US dollar, which helps you avoid crypto price volatility while still getting the benefits of blockchain payments.

What happens if a payment fails?

If a crypto payment fails or expires, the order is automatically cancelled, and the customer can try again or choose a different payment method.

Is this crypto plugin secure?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress and WooCommerce security best practices. All API communications are encrypted, and webhook signatures are verified on every callback.

Can I test before going live?

Absolutely! Use test API credentials from your AURAS Pay dashboard to test the full crypto payment flow without processing real transactions.

Do you offer refunds?

Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible. If you need to refund a customer, you will need to send them cryptocurrency manually from your wallet.

Does this work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. AURAS Pay supports both the classic checkout and the newer WooCommerce Blocks (Cart & Checkout) experience.

What if I need help?

Contact our support team at support@auraspay.com or visit our support forum.
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Improved crypto checkout compatibility with the latest WooCommerce releases
  • Enhanced WooCommerce Blocks (Cart & Checkout) support
  • More reliable on-chain payment verification and webhook handling
  • Performance and stability improvements
  • Updated documentation and SEO-friendly readme

1.1.0 – 2025-10-27

  • Production ready release
  • Added comprehensive unit test suite
  • Restored proper gateway availability checks
  • Removed force-enable logic (gateway now respects settings)
  • Cleaned up debug scripts and workarounds
  • Enhanced security and validation
  • Improved code quality and maintainability
  • BREAKING: Gateway must be manually enabled in settings

1.0.7 – 2024

  • Fixed AJAX 400 error with webhook URL handling
  • Fixed QR code display issues
  • Added support for multiple API response formats
  • Temporary workarounds for gateway visibility

1.0.0 – 2024-01-15

  • Initial release
  • Multi-cryptocurrency support (SOL, USDC, BTC, ETH)
  • QR code payment interface
  • Real-time payment verification
  • Webhook integration
  • Automatic currency conversion
  • Debug logging
  • Mobile-optimized payment page
  • Comprehensive admin settings
